titulo: My Smart Speaker Says Goodnight to Someone Else #Shorts
titulo_pt: Minha caixa de som inteligente dá boa noite para outra pessoa
resumo_pt: Uma mulher que mora sozinha ouve a assistente de voz dar boa noite a uma tal de Emma. Ao perguntar quem é Emma, a assistente diz que Emma é a dona da casa, que comprou o imóvel em maio, e que não recebe comandos de mais ninguém. A virada: a narradora é quem está assombrando a casa.
descricao:
My speaker keeps talking to a woman named Emma. I live alone. At least, I thought I did.

When did you figure it out?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: Last night, my smart speaker said goodnight to someone named Emma.
scenes.visual: small smart speaker glowing with a blue ring on a dark kitchen counter

scenes.text: Goodnight, Emma. Your alarm is set for seven.
I live alone. I've lived here for forty years.
scenes.visual: old cozy living room at night, armchair, lace curtains, single lamp

scenes.text: So I asked it. Who is Emma?
scenes.visual: woman's wrinkled hand resting next to a glowing smart speaker in the dark

scenes.text: That's ridiculous. This is my house.
scenes.visual: old framed photos on a hallway wall, slightly crooked, dim light
dark hallway leading to a half-open bedroom door, faint light inside

scenes.text: A young woman was asleep in my bed.
scenes.visual: young woman sleeping in a bed in a modern bedroom, moonlight, phone charging on nightstand

scenes.text: My furniture was gone. The walls were a different color.
scenes.visual: modern minimalist bedroom with fresh paint and moving boxes in the corner
smart speaker blue ring pulsing on a modern nightstand

scenes.text: Sorry. I only take commands from Emma. She bought the house in May.
Emma opened her eyes. She looked right at me. And she screamed.
scenes.visual: young woman sitting up in bed in the dark, staring at an empty doorway, terrified

scenes.text: I don't understand why everyone keeps screaming at me.
scenes.visual: faint transparent silhouette of an old woman standing in a dark doorway
